title: Quantum graviton scattering with definite helicities in the null surface formulation. III: Fourth-order recursion and ultraviolet finiteness
summary: We extend the perturbative null-surface formulation (NSF) scattering map to fourth order and derive an all-order recursion for the quantum cut. After the antipodal matching, both cone sources are evaluated on the same retarded solution determined by the free incoming radiative data. The perturbative NSF equations therefore determine every coefficient $Z_n$ from that data, without introducing new independent asymptotic information.
